responses.content: Dan Finlay is a core original developer and long-time lead maintainer of MetaMask, the Ethereum browser wallet launched by Consensys in 2016. He led development of MetaMask’s core infrastructure, including key management, dApp integration, and cross-browser support, and was a primary contributor to EIP-1193, the standardized JavaScript Provider API that underpins wallet-to-dApp connectivity across the Ethereum ecosystem. He was also a prominent early Ethereum community advocate for wallet usability and security best practices. He stepped down from his lead MetaMask maintainer role in 2022 per public announcements.
